patientFeedback.title: What Our Neurology Patients Say After Treatment
patientFeedback.subtitle: Real patient recovery journeys and post-treatment reflections from CareFirst Neurology.

items.name: David Harris
items.quote: I suffered from 18 to 20 migraine days a month for five years. Nothing worked until CareFirst's neuro team performed targeted nerve evaluations and adjusted my protocol with modern CGRP therapy. I now have fewer than 2 mild headaches a month. It has literally given me my career and family life back.
items.outcome: 90% Reduction in Pain Days • Return to Full Work

items.name: Sunita Aggarwal
items.quote: After my mild ischemic stroke, the immediate intervention and coordinated outpatient neuro-rehab at CareFirst helped me regain hand grip and clear speech within four months. The doctors treat you with profound respect and patience.
items.outcome: Independent Mobility • Speech & Fine Motor Restored

items.name: Manish Vohra
items.quote: The digital nerve conduction studies finally identified the exact root cause of my burning foot pain. The targeted treatment regimen reversed my numbness within twelve weeks. I can sleep peacefully without discomfort again.
items.outcome: Painless Walking • Sound Restful Sleep Restored
